display_long_description:
You begin with simply a front desk and a dream. Greet pedestrians on a busy street, manage the entrance wait, and sell gym passes to eager consumers. Purchase treadmills, bench presses, and new machines to keep your gym packed and your customers pumping iron
[media]

Bathe and clean your customer, physical VR mechanics to scrub them down. Spray, wash, and watch the dirt wash away in real-time until they are perfectly clean and ready to claim a seat in the relaxing wood-fired sauna.



**Satisfying VR Interactions: Physically spray and scrub down dirty customers in the shower using real-time dirt-erasing mechanics.**

**Smart AI Customers: Watch your gym come alive as characters dynamically queue, bypass full lines, work out, bathe, and relax in the sauna.**

**Expand & Upgrade: Reinvest your profits into new gym equipment to support more customers.**

**Realistic Economy: Track your net revenue, pay daily utilities, earn cleanliness bonuses, and avoid going bankrupt.**
